text: {"545":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"API servers serve the peer-aggregated discovery document by default."},"546":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"The API server behavior supports requesting a non-peer-aggregated discovery document via an Accept header."},"547":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"It specifies which discovery request types and endpoint the API server supports for peer aggregation."},"548":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"The aggregation layer is part of the API server and loads the mixed-version proxy filter."},"549":{"about":["kube-apiserver"],"refers":[],"why":"An API server proxies requests to a capable peer when it cannot serve the requested API."}}
